Name: TEXT_EMBED_IMAGE_PARAM_ST
Description: Size and vertical spacing of images embedded in game text (the img tag), one row per image.

Fields.Name: Display Scale
Fields.Description: Size of the image in the text, in percent of its own size. 0: use Display Height instead.

Fields.Name: Display Height
Fields.Description: Used when Display Scale is 0: height of the image in the text, in pixels; the width keeps the image's proportions. 0 (with scale 0): the image's own size.

Fields.Name: Vertical Offset
Fields.Description: Vertical spacing of the image in the line, in pixels. Retail -128 to 0.
